title: Pantry
summary: Track what's in your fridge, freezer, and cupboards — with barcode scanning.

cards.heading: What Pantry does
cards.body: Pantry keeps a running inventory of what you have at home, split by zone: fridge, freezer, and cupboard. Nothing leaves your device.

cards.heading: Adding items by scan
cards.body: Tap **+ Add item** then **Scan barcode**. Iron Rabbit reads the code offline and fetches product name, brand, and health info from Open Food Facts.

cards.heading: Adding items manually
cards.body: Tap **+ Add item** and type the name. Pick a zone and a quantity. Skip the scan entirely if you don't have a barcode handy.

cards.heading: Tip: Check Nutri-Score
cards.body: **Tip:** For any scanned item, tap **Product Info** to see Nutri-Score, NOVA processing, allergens, and additive warnings. Great for spotting palm oil.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Deleted items leave no trail. If you might restock later, move the item to a different zone instead of deleting it.
